paragraphs: Deal Go – Scam Towed. Every deal compared and checked.

SigPath searches live marketplaces at once and shows the best price, with shipping included, and checks a price from any other shop (Amazon, AliExpress, anywhere) against the same live market. It then checks every result before you buy: is the price plausible for the condition, is the photo recycled from another seller, is the account brand new, has a verified buyer reported this seller for fakes? Pay through SigPath and your money waits in an on-chain escrow until the order ships, or comes back to you automatically. No account, no sign-in, no tracking.
Built for the Solana × Superteam Germany hackathon.

requirements.text: No account, no sign-in, no tracking.
Amazon retired the Product Advertising API that sources/amazon.ts uses (2026); its successor, the Creators API, needs an Associates account with 10 sales in 30 days.
Amazon's product API needs 10 sales first, AliExpress's needs approved keys, and fetching their pages from a server means scraping, blocked datacenter IPs, paid proxies and CAPTCHAs.

On an ordinary cloud box the capture check could not run at all. remote speaks plain POST /v1/chat/completions, which nearly every inference host implements — so OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepInfra, Fireworks, a self-hosted vLLM, or Ollama on some other machine are all one env change apart, with no new dependency.
